sign_convention: above = surface above base (stockpile volume); below = surface below base
method: per-cell (upper − lower) × cell area, summed separately for positive and negative cells; boundary cells weighted by the fraction inside the polygon (gdal raster zonal-stats --pixels fractional)

zones.name: twin piles
